runtime: CPython 3.11.9, Windows host, standard library only
scope: Host CPU-only bounded finite-state construction experiment; no container, GUI, model, GPU, CUDA, network, or external effect.

decision.pass: root-state-only pair checking does not certify inapplicable COMMIT safe; reachable-state closure finds a pair of individually valid commits whose join violates at-most-once; serial baseline rejects the second commit; independent raw audit and all frozen corruptions pass.
decision.fail: root-only checker certifies COMMIT safe, closure misses the witness, local branch invalid, or serial baseline admits duplicate semantic effect.
decision.uncertain: A result depends on an unpinned history/precondition or invariant interpretation.

limits: Finite synthetic counterexample only; no general I-confluence proof.
Authorization is persistent within the fixture; revocation, quotas, timing, distributed message loss and retries are not modeled.
Commit records model at-most-once semantic identity and are not real side effects.
